title: Glashaus — IPFS Pinning
description: Pin files and websites to IPFS from Claude. x402 USDC payments on Base — no account needed.

environmentVariables.name: GLASHAUS_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: EVM private key for signing x402 payment challenges (0x-prefixed hex). The wallet must hold USDC on Base. Optional — can be configured interactively via `npx glashaus-mcp` or set at runtime with the import_wallet tool.
